title: Align slanted case-study link with content
context: The Read more label is currently positioned in the skewed surface coordinate space, so at desktop it no longer shares the case-frame content's left edge.

tasks.title: Align the slanted case-study link label with its content frame
acceptance_criteria: At 48rem and above, each Read more label's visible left edge aligns with its case content's visible left edge while both remain upright.
The existing full visible-surface native link hit area, mobile layout, keyboard focus, and no-JavaScript behavior are unchanged.
Browser coverage asserts desktop alignment for both case-study cards, and npm run verify plus an independent evaluator pass.
